verdict.rationale: Jira explicitly offers agile sprint templates and issue linking that support sprint planning (jira-docs-5, jira-comm-5, jira-comm-11), but community feedback highlights friction in actual sprint/epic tracking workflows—e.g., difficulty seeing tickets in closed sprints and confusing epic closure (jira-comm-17), plus general UI sluggishness and bloat (jira-comm-14, jira-comm-19).
